=== bi-getenv
--- main
A : [%getenv("PATH")] %strlen(%getenv("line.separator")) %ord(%getenv("line.separator")) %getenv("path.separator")
A : [%getenv("plantuml.security.credentials.path")] [%getenv("PLANTUML_SECURITY_PROFILE")] [%getenv("PlantUML.Security.x")]
A : [%getenv("PLANTUML_NO_SUCH_VARIABLE_XYZ")] [%getenv("")] [%getenv("user.dir")] [%getenv("LINE.SEPARATOR")]
=== bi-getenv-profile
--- profile: SANDBOX
--- main
A : [%getenv("PLANTUML_SECURITY_PROFILE")] %strlen(%getenv("line.separator")) [%getenv("PATH")]
=== bi-getenv-unsecure
--- profile: UNSECURE
--- main
A : [%getenv("NO_SUCH_VARIABLE_XYZ")] [%getenv("PLANTUML_SECURITY_PROFILE")] %getenv("path.separator")
=== bi-getenv-unsecure-empty
--- profile: UNSECURE
--- main
A : %getenv("")
=== bi-file-exists
--- file: here.txt
x
--- main
A : %file_exists("") %file_exists("/work") %file_exists("/nonexistent/zz") %file_exists("/etc/passwd") %file_exists("/")
A : %file_exists("here.txt") %file_exists("/work/") %file_exists("//work")
=== bi-file-exists-sandbox
--- profile: SANDBOX
--- main
A : %file_exists("/work") %file_exists("/")
=== bi-random
--- main
!$r = %random()
!if $r >= 0 && $r < 2
A : r0 ok
!endif
!$r = %random(10)
!if $r >= 0 && $r < 10
A : r1 ok
!endif
!$r = %random(5, 8)
!if $r >= 5 && $r < 8
A : r2 ok
!endif
!$r = %random(2147483647)
!if $r >= 0
A : r3 ok
!endif
!$r = %random(-5, -3)
!if $r >= -5 && $r < -3
A : r4 ok
!endif
A : %random(1) %random(7, 8) %random(-1, 0) %random("x", 1)
=== bi-random-zero
--- main
A : %random(0)
=== bi-random-negative
--- main
!$r = %random(-5)
=== bi-random-empty-range
--- main
A : %random(5, 5)
=== bi-random-reversed
--- main
A : %random(8, 5)
=== bi-random-overflow
--- main
A : %random(-2147483648, 2147483647)
=== bi-random-string
--- main
A : %random("x")
=== bi-random-three-args
--- main
!$r = %random(1, 2, 3)
=== bi-stdlib
--- main
A : %get_json_type(%get_all_stdlib()) %get_json_type(%get_all_stdlib(1)) %get_json_type(%get_stdlib())
=== bi-stdlib-missing
--- main
A : %get_stdlib("nolib")
=== bi-stdlib-missing-key
--- main
A : %get_stdlib("nolib", "version")
=== bi-theme
--- file: puml-theme-zzlocal.puml
---
name: zzlocal
author: me
author: you
---
skinparam backgroundColor red
--- main
A : %get_current_theme() %get_json_type(%get_all_theme())
!theme zzlocal
A : %get_current_theme()
!$t = %get_current_theme()
A : $t.name $t.author %json_key_exists($t, "name")
=== bi-crash-substr-affectation
--- main
!$x = %substr("hello", -1)
A : not reached
=== bi-crash-regex-affectation
--- main
!$x = %splitstr_regex("a", "(")
A : not reached
=== bi-crash-stdlib-affectation
--- main
!$x = %get_stdlib("nolib")
A : not reached
=== bi-crash-json-add-affectation
--- main
!$o = {"a": 1}
!$x = %json_add($o, "z")
A : not reached
=== bi-crash-random-if
--- main
!if %random(0) == 0
A : not reached
!endif
